Steps to Connect GPT
Ensure GPT Integration: Make sure that GPT is properly integrated into your UI. This might involve setting up a connection to the GPT service, ensuring that the UI can communicate with GPT, and configuring the necessary settings.
Prepare GPT Responses: Before you connect GPT, ensure that you have prepared the responses or conversations you want to display alongside your interactions. This might include setting up GPT to respond to specific prompts or to generate content that aligns with the context of your conversations.
Display GPT Responses: In your UI, you will need to display both your responses and GPT’s responses. This might involve updating the conversation history, displaying GPT’s responses in a separate section, or integrating GPT’s responses directly into the conversation flow.
